content:
It's time to take a look at our carefully curated latest recommendations for iPhone 18 Pro phone cases. Apple has launched a brand new silicone case and TechWoven fabric case series, with color designs that match the device, along with our long-trusted third-party brand favorites. From the new burgundy model with a built-in stand, to ultra-slip-resistant customizable models, to premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods—whatever you're looking for, we've got it. We've also found affordable options from value brands like Spigen, with prices starting as low as $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Updated 9/27: Added multiple exclusive promo codes for 9to5 readers to use.

Apple

Featured Partner: ESR

ESR's brand new iPhone 18 Pro case and accessory lineup is now available, bringing top-tier color craftsmanship, patented technology, and more highlights. The star of this new product release is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case, equipped with a zinc alloy Flex stand built into the camera protection area, offering 3x military-grade protection and a "soft and comfortable grip." Like other accessory series, the new Atelier also comes in four color options, perfectly matching the burgundy, glacial, black, and silver iPhone 18 Pro bodies.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case (with Flex Stand) $42 (original $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Stand (Anti-slip Edition) $46 (original $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is one of the industry's top brands, and their flagship models now fully support iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year they also launched the new Rugged Case series, with each color engraved with topographic contour patterns from Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to launch their classic Grip case, supporting iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Beyond its clean look and ultra-slip-resistant feel, it once again supports a wide range of customizable skin stickers, and adding a compatible Prism screen protector unlocks an additional discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $55 Customizable, drop protection, ultra-slip-resistant, crisp button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) 2-pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Easy install, auto-alignment, zero dust particles

This year Dbrand also launched their new MNML brand case, priced as low as $39, featuring minimalist aesthetics, better value, MagSafe compatibility, and the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Military Blue, Tan, Burgundy

We've also secured an exclusive 20% discount for 9to5 readers on this brand new iPhone 18 Pro case:

UAG

UAG has also launched a lineup of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, including their signature rugged models featuring reinforced corner protection, slip-resistant bumpers, and various drop-focused designs. If you're looking for a case built for heavy use and everyday protection, UAG's lineup is well worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve $65 (for iPhone Duo)
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 (for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max)
  • UAG Civilian Slip-Resistant Case from $60
  • And more…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you want a rugged case for your new phone but don't want to go with common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is worth a look. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop tests, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotatable stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a less bulky yet more premium case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. They now offer ultra-thin Aramid fiber cases for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, with other recommended models listed below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fiber Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fiber Case $70
  • And more…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases lean toward more forward-thinking designs, featuring futuristic styling, slim profiles, and unique textures that stand out among common cases.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case $60 (for iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users追求 thinness. Their cases typically use lightweight Aramid fiber with a clean, minimalist look while remaining MagSafe compatible, and feature reinforced protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Texture Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Aramid Drop Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox has a lineup of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases ready, ranging from slim everyday models to rugged heavy-duty designs, catering to different protection needs. Many new models support MagSafe, and some add features like slip-resistant sides, accessory storage, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, letting you choose based on your preferences for thickness and protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more…

Belkin

If you're looking for a cleaner, lighter case than fully rugged options for your iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Belkin is a reliable brand. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear cases and protective cases with raised edges around the screen and camera. Some models, like Protect+, add reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2 Compatible MagSafe Slip-Resistant Case $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is another brand that typically jumps out ahead with new iPhone cases, and their iPhone 18 Pro lineup is already on sale with a rich selection. The brand is best known for colorful designs, bold patterns, and protection that doesn't look too tool-like. Most models in the lineup support MagSafe, with clear, impact-resistant, and more fashionable options available.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case (MagSafe compatible) $64
  • And more…

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro lineup continues the brand's everyday protection style with clean designs. The lineup includes many slim, slip-resistant cases, as well as MagSafe-compatible models and clear designs that let you show off your phone's original color. These cases also provide decent drop protection without making the phone too bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 (for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max)
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case (MagSafe compatible) $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case (MagSafe compatible) $40
  • And more…

elago

elago cases lean toward clean, minimalist designs and are more affordable than other options. The lineup typically includes slim silicone, clear, and MagSafe-compatible models in simple colors that perfectly complement Apple's device colors.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (original $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (original $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (original $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more…
